description: Seeded expectations for fv-qualify. Model verdicts are environment/mode-aware and computed by fv-qualify at runtime (PASS only with Java 21+ AND exhaustive verify enabled; PASS-WITHOUT-EXHAUSTIVE with --skip-verify or without Java 21+); they are documented here for human review, not duplicated as constants the battery could drift from.

cases.expectation: gateVerdict/aggregateVerdict match 10 seeded cases incl. fail-closed legacy handling
fv-run verdict equals the environment-aware expectation (PASS with Java 21+, else PASS-WITHOUT-EXHAUSTIVE)
fv-mutate verdict PASS: every applicable seeded guard-weakening mutant is killed
fv-probe PASS against the correctly-authorized demo target
fv-probe FAIL against the BOLA/mass-assignment demo target (detection, not absence of bugs)
claim engine: init, catalog adoption, born-UNSUPPORTED/FV-0, link raises to FV-1, hyper cap honored
GSN case exports (md+json) with residuals section and no prohibited certification language
fv-stale exit 0 on an untouched demo graph
fv-trace PASS replaying the recorded demo trace
fault plan validates; filled execution record checks out
route inventory written for the examples tree
coverage measured for token_lifecycle against its evidence
SARIF BOLA result lands as one HYPOTHESIS mapped to CLM-AUTHZ-004, never auto-promoted

rules: A case that cannot execute is a failed case, never a pass.
Expectations change only with a reviewed harness change and a CHANGELOG entry.
This file describes the battery; fv-qualify remains the executable source of truth.
